reviews.review:
It's bad. Like, REALLY bad. Like, every character looks like it was made in one of those old Illusion-style CM3D type games, and the writing and animations and gameplay are all of the same caliber.

It appears that the dev tried to pad out the length of the game and/or add "replayability" by slapping in some BS weapon unlock/upgrade system, but all that does is mean the game is a grindfest unless you actually WANT to spend bulk of the story working with crappy underpowered weapons.

The gameplay itself is fine, it's pretty obvious that it was made with an eye towards the classic arcade lightgun games like Time Crisis and the like, but that experience just doesn't translate well into a keyboard and mouse control scheme. A mediocre game bogged down by godawful character models, writing that comes off like a fifth grader's generic wannabe cyberpunk-lite MGS fanfiction, and a forced grind that turns the gameplay itself (the only truly tolerable part of this mess) into a slog and a chore.

1/10 one of the worse decisions in my Steam library, and that's truly saying something.
